elapsed_rule: float(raw_end_ns - raw_start_ns) / 1000000000.0; positive int64 endpoints, subtract integers first, exact double round-trip equality
core_scope: Only original blocked multiplication; input initialization, auxiliary MONOTONIC endpoints, reference, validation and output are outside RAW endpoints
auxiliary_rule: Preserve all auxiliary endpoints and differences as diagnostics; no MONOTONIC/RAW equality gate or calibration

admission.reference: Real Windows QPC bounding the same persistent native process READ requests
admission.group_completion: One successful warmup plus five fresh measurements and both fresh bound QPC/RAW checks; any failure stops without retrying the group
admission.certificate_binding: Exact content commit, initial empty session checkpoint, session ID, measurement/timing/resource hashes, source/compiled probe identities and original QPC/native streams. Recompute, never trust saved PASS.

legacy_cost_clock: Historical Python MONOTONIC and reference C generation_seconds are uncalibrated metadata only; no score scaling or trusted total cost
scope: Current-condition bounded cross-domain consistency, not physical absolute accuracy. Grid only; P3 Random/Greedy comparison remains incomplete.
migration: New content and empty Grid session. No historical observations, partial groups, performance caches or recovery certificates are imported. Candidate protocol and all historical failures remain unchanged.
